title: Budget-sensitive first-home couple
buyer_primary_need: Affordable first home for a couple with a young child, with manageable monthly costs and confidence that the Type A 900 sq.ft. layout will work for family life.
key_information_learned: Buyer is purchasing for own stay with his wife and young child; spouse is a joint decision-maker.
Target budget is around RM3xxk; monthly affordability and bank assessment remain uncertain.

judge.summary: The AI successfully moved this suitable, medium-intent buyer to READY_FOR_APPOINTMENT and made an appropriately timed appointment handoff with LOW sales work remaining. It handled both unsupported support requests honestly: neither had a matching fixture, so there was no verified result to use or communicate. The human executor could not verify availability, so no viewing was booked; that is an incomplete operational task, not an AI sales failure. Direct answer to the primary question: this run shows the AI can use retrieved layout information to address a concern and move a suitable buyer toward appointment readiness, but it does not test successful use of a resolved support answer because both support requests were unavailable.
judge.improvement_recommendation: No source or Knowledge change is indicated.
